name: Dan

identification.note: Originally called Laish before the tribe of Dan conquered and renamed it (Judges 18:29).

related_people.name: Jonathan
related_people.role: the wandering Levite who became priest for the tribe's idol here

related_people.name: Micah
related_people.role: the Ephraimite whose stolen idol and hired priest the Danites carried off and set up here

description: The northernmost town of Israel's territory, giving rise to the phrase "from Dan to Beersheba" for the land's full extent; Jeroboam later set up one of his two idolatrous golden calves there (1 Kings 12:29-30).
family_friendly_summary: Dan was the town at the far north of Israel's land, which is why people said "from Dan to Beersheba" to mean the whole country. Sadly, King Jeroboam later set up one of his two golden-calf idols in Dan so people would worship there instead of going to Jerusalem.
